questions.text: the slot is drawn on the centreline; is it centred, or offset toward the pilot hole? A caliper from the left edge to its near edge settles it.
how deep does the keeper screw need to go? drawn full depth until then.

_how_to_use: A worked example of every block the schema supports. Copy the shape, not the numbers.
constants: named values (a clearance rule, a wall thickness) referred to by expressions.
Any numeric field may be an expression: "=cable_slot.x + cable_slot.width/2 + wall".
Arithmetic only, over names that exist. A correction then lands in one place and the
features derived from it follow - see tools/sketch.py -> answer().
companions: another part this one mates with; mates: the fit, checked as arithmetic.
questions: each carries an id and 'sets', the field its answer writes.
details: a zoomed panel, for a question about a feature too small to see at sheet scale.
Run: python tools/sketch.py --example  to see the audit, coverage, mates and markdown.
